audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Yone six of seven rows including 2+ items, while the whys text on the same page said levels 3-5 are a skill check, level 6 is Yone's spike, and 'late the game is Nasus's'. The chart and the prose disagreed on four rows.
audit.why: The packet chart (Yone / Yone / Skill / Skill / Yone / Yone / Nasus) matches the prose and a 49.14% win rate over 2546 games — a lane Yone wins early and loses to full stacks.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4-5 set to Skill, level 6 set to Yone, 2+ items set to Nasus, in matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues: nothing told the player when to fight. Wither, the ability the whole page is built around, never had a cooldown attached.
audit.why: Wither is 15/14/13/12/11s — long enough that its downtime is the actual trade window, and that is the concrete instruction the page was missing.
audit.corrected: Added the 11-15s Wither clock to dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why, and Siphoning Strike's 3.5-7.5s auto-reset rhythm to dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wither was written as something that makes your dashes useless. Mortal Steel's dash is a fixed movement and Wither does not stop it. What Wither actually does is cut attack speed — and Spirit Cleave's cooldown AND cast time both scale with attack speed, so Wither directly stretches your shield cooldown and slows the swing. Fate Sealed was again called a knockup setter; it is a blink behind the last champion in a line plus a pull. Fury of the Sands' percent-health damage was nowhere, so the page implied armour was the answer.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Spirit Cleave states the attack-speed scaling verbatim; the mirror audit (nasus__yone) recorded the same finding, so both sides now state it identically.
audit.corrected: Wither restated as a cooldown-extension on Spirit Cleave, Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull, and Fury of the Sands' percent-health damage stated where the page discusses building against him.

audit.why: 'Let him free-stack', 'fight inside his W slow' and 'let the game go late' are the three real errors and they are already the three don'ts.
audit.corrected: Only the supporting detail under 'fight inside his W slow' was replaced, since it described a cooldown-waste that had nothing to do with Wither.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Spirit Visage' in spikes[2].text as a probable corruption of Spirit Cleave. It is a false positive — Spirit Visage is a real item and a real Nasus buy, so the text was left alone. Wither's true effect on Yone is that Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed; it does not stop Mortal Steel's dash, and the page previously claimed it did.
